Delivered UI integration, 2026-10-26
Related issue: #99, submitter eliasstepanik. Expanded user request covers the
new UI pack under spritesheets/UI, including menu art and Hollow Sigil font.

Implementation
- Copied eight 128x64 precolored atlases, metadata, CC0 license and WOFF2
  unchanged from the delivery. Runtime PNG/font payload: 11,239 bytes.
- Vite imports inline these small assets into the hashed game bundle. No CDN
  or external runtime service. Source sheets and character slots remain 0/1;
  new UI slots follow, legacy packed sheets follow all external sheets.
- Native five-heart full/lost/empty states; 180ms loss frame, per-slot tracking
  preserves previously empty slots, supports multi-heart loss and healing.
  All tracking lives in optional render resources, not serialized State.
- Stone frames for hotbar, HUD and keycaps; Candlelit Menu frames/selection
  overlays and pointer cues for buttons and panels. Corners keep source size.
- Three torch frames at 6fps, normal/copper/sodium/strontium themes in HUD and
  Help, tiled fuel fill clipped to whole source pixels and bright leading tip.
- Supplied pointer reused for depth and opt-in developer navigation. No normal
  exit arrow is re-enabled; guide wisp navigation remains unchanged.
- Local Hollow Sigil WOFF2 loaded lazily, retained through HMR, with a system
  fallback on load failure. Browser font rasterization may apply antialiasing;
  the delivery's optional bitmap-font rendering path is not required here.
- Menu/in-game text colors and menu eye/spark accents use delivered palette.
- No dedicated depth/exit/keycap sheet is present in this delivery. Reuse the
  supplied pointer/panel rather than inventing replacement art. This user
  pack supersedes the older sprite dimensions/art direction in issue #99.

Verification
- Full npm check passed with 64MB Node nursery; build passed. Added heart-UI
  regression and structural UI asset/font/license/bundle check to the suite.
- 88 browser native sprite comparisons (all 11 shapes x eight palettes):
  exact pixel matches against the decoded source atlas rectangles.
- 400 nine-slice corner pixels checked at 24x24, 121x41, 320x140 and 16x16.
- Fuel clipping at 0/25/50/100% yielded 0/120/240/480 nontransparent pixels.
- Recorded all three heart states and all three torch frames in four themes.
- 20 screen/viewport combinations: title, Help, pause, death and win at
  360x640, 640x360, 1280x800, 1920x1080; all three Help pages rendered.
- Actual native title/HUD/Help/win screenshots inspected. Local font loaded,
  no browser exceptions, HUD State JSON unchanged, ?ph=1 fallback works.
- Real main.ts host HMR preserves run/developer choices and live resources.
- README provenance/license and changelog included; owner docs snapshot
  unchanged and may be re-synced to reflect this replacement asset pack.

Acceptance
Implemented and verified for the delivered pack. Await user visual confirmation;
keep #99 OPEN / IN PROGRESS rather than treating automated proof as approval.

#99 bar placement follow-up, 2026-10-26 (submitter eliasstepanik)
- User clarified that duration stays in the upper-left torch info box.
- Removed the active-mineral underline. Raised duration fill/track by 4u
  inside its existing box so it clears the lower nine-slice rim. Hotbar slots,
  selection frame, control hint, material label and fuel behavior unchanged.
- Full checks and build passed; actual-host HMR passed. Four browser sizes
  verified fuel bounds remain above the bottom rim, no active underline is
  drawn, hint position and serialized State remain unchanged. No errors.
- Await user confirmation; #99 remains open.
